title: Unnamed insider on a UFO crash retrieval team out of the Nevada Test and Training Range, with an NRO badge and Q clearance
place_text: Nevada Test and Training Range, Tonopah Test Range, Nevada

tellings.quote: Uh, one of whom specifically has claimed to have operated on a crash retrieval team, UFO crash retrieval team out of the Nevada Test and Training Range.

plain: An unnamed insider is said to have worked on a UFO crash retrieval team, a group that recovers crashed craft, based out of the Nevada Test and Training Range, a large military range that includes the Tonopah Test Range. The researcher known as UAPGerb tells Michels about this person, saying one of his contacts "specifically has claimed to have operated on a crash retrieval team." The insider is described as holding a badge from the NRO, the National Reconnaissance Office, which runs US spy satellites, and a Q clearance, the Energy Department's clearance for nuclear secrets. If true, it would mean the US runs a hidden program to recover crashed UFOs.
